# Price the plan, not just the service call.

> Free HVAC maintenance contract pricing calculator. Price preventive visits, callbacks, parts reserve, overhead, and target margin without underbidding the agreement.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [This calculator vs. a flat monthly fee](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/hvac-maintenance-contract-calculator/vs-a-flat-monthly-fee.html)
